assessments.reasoning: The lexical reference links statement grouping to logical-line indentation. An increased level pushes a stack entry and emits INDENT. A valid decrease emits DEDENT for each level removed.

challenge.method: Check equal indentation, a decrease to a previously unseen level, and end of file.
challenge.results: Equal indentation emits neither token. A decrease must match a stacked level. End of file closes remaining positive levels, so a DEDENT need not originate at the start of another line.

limitations: The claim covers source tokenization of logical lines. The reference separately specifies physical-line joining and tab handling.
The sample uses spaces and the edition text, rather than the sample, establishes the tab, form-feed and error rules.
